title: Measurement of Steady-State ATP Levels and NAD+/NADH Ratios
author: Wen Aw
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rted6je

steps.title: Extract metabolites from larvae
steps.instruction: Extract ATP, NAD+, and NADH metabolites from female third instar wandering larvae harbouring Alstonville and Dahomey mtDNA raised on 1:2 P:C and 1:16 P:C diets (7 replicates per mitotype-diet combination).

steps.title: Analyze metabolites via LC-ESI-MS/MS
steps.instruction: Analyze the extracted metabolites using liquid chromatography (LC) electrospray ionisation tandem mass spectrometry (ESI-MS/MS).

steps.title: Determine ATP levels
steps.instruction: Quantify ATP levels by measuring the area under the curve.

steps.title: Calculate NAD+/NADH ratio
steps.instruction: Calculate the NAD+/NADH ratio based on the relative differences in peak areas between NAD+ and NADH metabolites.
